tutorial_intro.message: This text-only guide explains the main features with tables. Recommended setup: make Whale Navigation your browser home page for one-click access.

tutorial_intl_html.message:
1. Getting started

Install for free from the official Chrome, Edge or Firefox extension store. Setting this page as your browser home page is recommended.

Set the home page
Chrome: open chrome://settings/, choose On startup and Open a specific page. Edge and Firefox provide the same option under their home or startup settings. Copy the extension address from the address bar, for example chrome-extension://…/pages/popup.html.

2. Interface and search

AreaDescription
Top toolbarHome, local search, Bing, Google, All/My links, language, theme, admin and account controls.
Left categoriesJump to a category. Category names and icons follow the selected language.
Link cardsOpen links, reorder them, move them between categories or delete them by dragging.

3. Saving links

MethodHow it works
Add from pageClick the plus button, enter a title, URL and optional description, then choose a category and save.
Context menuRight-click a web page and choose Save to Whale Navigation. The navigation page opens a prefilled save dialog.
ShortcutPress Ctrl+Shift+K. You can change it in the extension shortcut settings.
Page or domainSwitch between saving the current page and saving the site home page with the detected site name.
DuplicatesURLs are normalized and existing duplicates are skipped.

4. Personal links and drag actions

FeatureDescription
Personal linksSign in to save private links. Accounts are isolated, and My shows only the current account.
Local filesOnly Personal links allow file:// or local paths. Enable Allow access to file URLs for the extension in chrome://extensions first.
ReorderDrag a card to another position inside the same category.
Move categoryDrag onto another category section or sidebar category, including between Personal and public categories.
DeleteA Delete link zone appears while dragging. Drop the card there and confirm.

5. Admin panel

The admin panel includes overview, categories, links, batch import, batch export, avatar settings, this tutorial and About. Administrators can add, edit, delete or hide links and filter them by category and keyword.

6. Batch import and export

FormatDescription
Category,Title,URLRecommended, one link per line. An unknown category falls back to the selected target category.
Title,URLTwo-column format, imported into the selected target category.
ExportExports UTF-8 TXT by category with category, title and URL, ready for import on another computer.
Examples
Common Sites,Baidu,https://www.baidu.com
Search Engines,Google,https://www.google.com

7. Themes, languages and privacy

Seven interface languages and six themes are available: Dawn, Deep Sea, Bamboo, Sunset, Ink and Midnight. This tutorial changes language with the interface.

  • Runs locally with no remote components, analytics or trackers.
  • Link data stays in the current browser and is not uploaded.
  • Navigation is available without an account; signing in enables Personal links.

8. FAQ

QuestionAnswer
Why does the icon open a full page?The full page provides more space. Set it as your browser home page for quick access.
Why am I asked to sign in?After signing in or registering, the prefilled save dialog continues automatically.
The shortcut does nothing.Check for a system shortcut conflict and change it in the extension management page.
How do I migrate data?Export TXT by category, then import it on the new computer.
What happens on uninstall?Local data is removed, so export a backup first.
